# LaplandTours

> Book a 2026 Lapland tour: six hand-picked UK & European operators, packages or build-your-own. Hotels, husky, aurora, Santa visits compared.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://laplandtours.online/): Plan a Lapland trip your way: package tours and build-your-own compared
- [The operators](https://laplandtours.online/lapland-holidays): Six tour companies for Finnish Lapland compared
- [Practical info](https://laplandtours.online/practical-info): Climate, visas and transport for Finnish Lapland
- [Age guide](https://laplandtours.online/age-guide): Which Lapland activities suit which age
- [Design your own trip](https://laplandtours.online/design-tour): Build your own Lapland trip step by step
